description: Practical workflows for installing Graphify, mapping codebases into knowledge graphs, and querying code and documentation with grounded graph paths.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me use Graphify to map and understand my project. Start with the right install or query workflow for my environment, and do not claim commands were run unless I provide their output.
interface.longDescription: Guides you through Graphify installation, codebase mapping, knowledge-graph queries, path tracing, explanations, and troubleshooting using Graphify's documented workflows. It provides instructions and generated commands; it does not run Graphify on your machine by itself.

name: graphify-agent
